articles.en: .. Purpose: this Law determines the procedure for civil fines provided for in the Code of Civil Procedure and in the laws on non-contentious civil procedure.

.. Universal application
The provisions of the law on non-contentious civil procedure shall likewise apply to the procedure for civil fines, except in cases where other provisions are laid down in this Law.
Chapter 2 Competence

Jurisdiction over civil fine cases shall lie with the court of first instance having jurisdiction over the place determined in Article 8 (jurisdiction of the court over cases determined by domicile, inter alia) of the Code of Civil Procedure of the parties to the civil fine procedure, except in cases where special provisions exist in other laws.
Chapter 3
Initiation of proceedings
.. The procedure for civil fines shall be initiated by the court of its own motion.

Procedure for ruling on civil fines
1- The ruling on civil fines shall be made by a decision.
2- The decision referred to in paragraph 1 above shall be made in writing, stating the reasons and the operative part, and the judge shall sign this decision.
3- In order to issue a decision on a civil fine, the court shall first seek the opinion of the prosecutor's representative and hear the arguments of the parties.
4- The prosecutor's representative and the parties may appeal against a decision on a civil fine. A decision imposing a civil fine shall have no effect unless it has become final.
5- Where a decision imposing a civil fine has been issued, the court costs necessary for the procedure of the decision on the civil fine, including the procedure for ruling on objections, shall be borne by the person who receives that decision; apart from such case, they shall be borne by the State.
6- Where a party lodges an objection against a decision imposing a civil fine and the court hearing the objection sets aside the original decision and issues a new decision on the civil fine, the court costs referred to in paragraph 5 above shall likewise be borne by the State, even if that decision is a decision imposing a civil fine.

.. Enforcement of a decision imposing a civil fine
1- A decision imposing a civil fine shall be enforced by order of the prosecutor's representative.
This order shall have the same effect as an enforcement instrument bearing the enforcement formula.
2- The enforcement of a decision imposing a civil fine shall be carried out in accordance with Article 6 of
[illegible] the Code of Civil Procedure or other legal instruments on enforcement procedure; it shall not be necessary to transmit the decision before enforcement.
3- If deemed necessary in order to enforce a decision imposing a civil fine, the prosecutor's representative may request a State institution or a public entity or a private entity to report on the necessary points.
Chapter 4 Final provisions

Implementation of this Law: this Law is declared to be urgent.
